lines.q: Which came first: the Eiffel Tower, Coca-Cola, Sherlock Holmes or the zipper?
lines.a: Coca-Cola, in eighteen eighty six! Three years before the Eiffel Tower.
Stonehenge! Its first stage was dug centuries before the Great Pyramid.
The microwave oven! It started as radar tech in the nineteen forties.
The Mayflower, in sixteen twenty! The Taj Mahal was started twelve years later.
Facebook, in two thousand four! YouTube came a year later.
Sliced bread, in nineteen twenty eight! Pluto wasn't even discovered yet. Think you got all six? Go again!
